Exactly one midpoint checkpoint at x4650, one sleeping selected-hero clone, persistent empty machine after dispense, no restock on death.
One Clogfather visible when eventually integrated; no simultaneous background duplicate and foreground boss.
Wastewater direction is intentional: less water and denser debris toward boss, stopped/full clog at terminal zone, including backtracking; environmental only.
Use natural varied writing. Rejected paired advertising fragments, generic meatbag jokes, excessive jargon in reader magazine.
Preserve originals/rejected art locally and provenance, but do not indiscriminately commit old magazines/discarded binary art.
